About

Welcome to
Creed Fitness

Plenty of gyms have machines. Few have a floor that makes you want to train hard. Creed Fitness was set up so members can walk in, put their head down and get the work done.

Why Creed

Why train here instead of anywhere else

A floor built for focus

Open layout, clear zones and equipment placed where you expect it. Less waiting, less wandering, more sets done.

Serious equipment

Racks, plate-loaded machines, cables and a full dumbbell wall, all kept clean and in working order.

Trainers who push

Coaches who check form, set targets and do not let you coast. Personal training comes with the yearly plan.

Recovery on site

Sauna, cold shower area and a massage area, so you can recover in the same building where you train.

Straight pricing

Four membership lengths, one family package. The more months you commit to, the lower your monthly rate.

Separate women's hours

Dedicated ladies timings with their own changing room, so everyone trains comfortably.

Our mission
We are here to help you reach your goals and stay there.

Whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, get stronger or just feel better every day, our job is the same: give you the space, the equipment and the coaching to make steady progress, and the support to keep going when it gets hard. Your goals set the pace. We set the standard.

Services

Equipment &
facilities

Everything on the floor, and everything around it that helps you train and recover.

On the floor

Machines & free weights

Free weights

A full dumbbell wall, Olympic barbells, plates and adjustable benches for the basics that build strength.

  • Dumbbells
  • Barbells
  • Plates
  • Adjustable benches

Plate-loaded machines

Heavy, stable machines for legs, chest and back, with the load you choose and the support to push close to failure.

  • Leg press
  • Hack squat
  • Chest press
  • Leg curl / extension

Cables & selectorized

Cable towers and pin-loaded machines that keep tension steady and make it easy to train every muscle group safely.

  • Cable crossover
  • Lat pulldown
  • Seated row
  • Pec deck

Racks & functional area

Squat racks, pull-up rigs and a turf strip for sled work, carries, battle ropes and mobility.

  • Squat racks
  • Pull-up rig
  • Turf strip
  • Medicine balls

Boxing & conditioning

Heavy bags and conditioning gear for rounds of work that raise your heart rate and clear your head.

  • Heavy bags
  • Gloves & bands
  • Battle ropes
  • Slam balls

Cardio area

Treadmills, bikes and cross trainers for warm-ups, steady runs and finishers, away from the heavy lifting.

  • Treadmills
  • Exercise bikes
  • Cross trainers
  • Rowers
